description: Block-form <match for=Phase on=@phase> arm swap (§18.0.1). A click sets @phase = Phase.Loading; the matching arm body swaps into the mount slot (idle arm gone, loading arm present). Whole-tree mode captures the arm in place (no wrapper, §18.0.1 amended S478); anchored asserts on the author's data-arm.
rationale: §18.0.1 match block-form: the dispatcher subscribes to @phase and swaps the matching arm on change. Driven by a user click (NOT a banned direct state-set). S478 open-Qs ruling item 13 (§18.0.1 amended S478): the dispatched arm renders in place of the `<match>`, with no wrapper element — the whole-tree `dom` no longer holds impl#1's match-mount `<div>`.
